title: InvisibilityPowder
description: Adds a powder that highlights invisible players in the area.
body:
# **Description**:
InvisibilityPowder is a unique Minecraft server plugin that introduces a special Revealing Powder to the game. This powder allows players to detect and expose invisible opponents, adding a new layer of strategy and excitement to PvP and PvE encounters.

Key Features:
Revealing Powder:
Players can craft the powder using a special recipe.
When used, the powder reveals invisible players within a specified radius.
Effects and Particles:
Visual effects (particles) and sounds are triggered upon using the powder, enhancing immersion.
Customizable particle and sound settings via the configuration file.
Customizable Parameters:
Adjustable radius of the powder's effect.
Cooldown time between uses.
Duration of the glowing effect.
Number and type of particles.
Admin Commands:
Grant the powder to players with ease.
Manage plugin settings via commands.
Multi-World Support:
The plugin works seamlessly across all worlds, making it versatile for any server setup.

(Was created for FrienMine)
